questions.statement: I can create a feature branch and switch between branches without losing work
I can check what a commit will contain before I make it (git status, git diff)
I can bring my branch up to date with my teammates' work using git fetch and git rebase origin/main
I can read conflict markers, including the base section, and say what each side changed
I can resolve a conflict in VS Code and continue the rebase
I can say which side is mine and which is my teammate's during a rebase
I can back out of a rebase partway through, and undo one I've finished
I can squash several small commits into one with git rebase -i
I can merge my branch into main with --ff-only, and recover when Git refuses
I can run the tests after a rebase and decide whether it's safe to push
I can read git log --graph and explain what has happened
I can agree a resolution with the teammate whose code conflicts with mine
I can get my work into main when other teammates are pushing at the same time
